title: Luxembourg Crisis
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Luxembourg Crisis", at revision 1339883033, opens: "The Luxembourg Crisis was a diplomatic dispute and confrontation in 1867 between France and Prussia over the political status of Luxembourg." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q699765, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Diplomatic dispute and confrontation". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
